@graph.name: Vienna Wet Month Prediction – FAIR ML Experiment (v1)
@graph.description: A fully documented, FAIR-compliant machine learning experiment that predicts whether a calendar month in Vienna (Hohe Warte station) is a wet month, defined as total monthly precipitation >= 60 mm. The experiment includes input data, preprocessing and training code, trained models, evaluation outputs, and comprehensive metadata.

@graph.name: Vienna Hohe Warte Raw Weather Data (v1)
@graph.description: Monthly weather observations from the Hohe Warte meteorological station in Vienna, Austria, spanning 1872 to 2023. Published by Stadt Wien under CC BY 4.0.

@graph.name: Model Training Script
@graph.description: Trains Logistic Regression and Random Forest classifiers on the Vienna weather dataset to predict wet months. Outputs serialised model artefacts.

@graph.name: Model Evaluation Script
@graph.description: Evaluates trained models on the test split and produces metrics, predictions, and visualisation figures.

@graph.name: Semantic Mapping Notebook (T2.2)
@graph.description: Maps dataset attributes to ontological concepts for semantic interoperability.

@graph.name: Unit Mapping Notebook (T2.3)
@graph.description: Maps numeric attributes to units of measurement using the SI Digital Framework ontology.

@graph.name: DBRepo Views Notebook (T2.4)
@graph.description: Creates SQL views in DBRepo for query-ready aggregations used in the ML pipeline.

@graph.name: DBRepo Data Loading Notebook (T2.5)
@graph.description: Loads the input weather dataset into DBRepo via the REST API.

@graph.name: DBRepo API Reimplementation Notebook (T2.6)
@graph.description: Reimplements data loading exclusively via the DBRepo REST API, replacing local file reads.
